name: manual_77e55c
claim: PowerShell 'Set-StrictMode -Version Latest' turns '(Get-Item -Path Env:VAR -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Value' into a hard error when VAR is unset (Get-Item returns $null, .Value on $null throws PropertyNotFoundStrict) — always null-guard the Get-Item result before dereferencing .Value under strict mode.

decisions.notes: start.ps1's Test-LanBindConfigured crashed on a completely fresh install specifically because none of PORTAL_BIND_LAN/ORAMA_BIND_LAN/PT_BIND_LAN were set yet — exactly the fresh-install case the function needed to handle gracefully. Fixed by assigning Get-Item's result to a variable and checking it for $null before accessing .Value.
